create_objective: create an Objective instance with a specified dtype and custom error metric function
add_cost_function: add a CostFunction to the Objective to register its optimization and auxiliary variables
erase_cost_function: erase a CostFunction from the Objective by name and clean up unused variables
evaluate_error: evaluate the concatenated error vector of all cost functions in the Objective
update_variables: update Objective variables with new tensors and resolve batch size consistency
